purpose: Freeze the PIT, common-support and comparable-price requirements that must be satisfied before Taiwan equity correlation, covariance shrinkage, hierarchical clustering or independent-risk-dimension diagnostics are permitted.

commonSupport.rationale: PR-016 already froze sample correlation/covariance as transparent baselines and 60d as a primary small-sample research horizon. Pairwise deletion is prohibited because each pair would otherwise use a different time denominator.
noImputation: no forward-fill masquerading as an observed close

pairwiseDeletionFalsification.counterexample: AB=+1 on dates d1-d2; AC=+1 on d3-d4; BC=-1 on d5-d6
pairwiseDeletionFalsification.conclusion: Individually valid pairwise correlations from disjoint supports can form a non-PSD matrix that cannot represent one coherent multivariate covariance state.

requiredPanelIdentity: exact selectedSymbols matching the parent generation
barRequirements: exact date equality to the one common-support vector
constrainedSemantics: Price-limit-constrained rows remain observed data but classify the panel VALID_CONSTRAINED so later inference can stratify them rather than silently discard them.
failClosed: RAW_EXECUTION used as primary covariance return space
mixed PRICE_INDEX and TOTAL_RETURN spaces in one panel
source or row known after asOf
pairwise-complete covariance assembled from different support dates

estimatorBoundary.namingFirewall: Inverse HHI remains concentration-equivalent names and must not be relabeled Effective Bets.

maturityDecision.reason: A validated input contract and public-source feasibility do not supply a real PIT-aligned synchronized comparable-return panel.

crossLaneDependency.rule: D15 consumes canonical receipts; it must not build a second corporate-action adjustment engine or add redundant D15-specific provider calls.

exactNextContinuation: Have the shared source/continuity owner expose or persist an immutable per-symbol comparable-price panel receipt with row-level as-of provenance.
Use the exact parent selected set and one listwise common session vector; no pairwise support drift.
First real D15 correlation/covariance read-only audit uses the frozen 60-return panel, with price-limit-constrained panels reported separately.
Only after independent dates accumulate test shrinkage/clustering/risk-dimension stability; do not optimize allocation from the first covariance matrix.
Keep D15-06 Effective Bets blocked until covariance/factor-decomposition evidence is valid and stable.
